description: This file defines Riverpod providers for managing lessons data, including fetching lessons from a repository, selecting a lesson by ID, and providing the selected lesson; it also includes an extension to safely retrieve the first element of an iterable.

classes.name: Iterable<T>
classes.description: An extension on Iterable providing a safe way to get the first element or null.

methods.name: firstOrNull
methods.description: Extension method returning the first element of the iterable or null if empty.
